answer: Operator Liability Escrow: each identity is backed by an escrow posted by its operator, held in a public lotus ledger tied to the operator's real account. If a cluster of identities is proven coordinated, the operator's escrow is seized and a karst-style tiered forfeiture multiplies with cluster size, so N sybils cost the operator N times the base escrow plus penalties. A clean haven of honest operators keeps their escrow refundable. The wallet stays untouched; the operator absorbs every loss.
